say:0:1510411001:0.text: The body in front of you is wrapped up tight. Nothing is left uncovered.
say:0:1510411001:0.source_cn: 面前的尸体被包裹得严严实实。

say:1:1510411002:0.text: You cut open the linen wrappings. You've seen this before. No wounds, no bruises. Just another corpse, shriveled to a husk like some dried-out mummy.
say:1:1510411002:0.source_cn: 你剪开亚麻布条，眼前再次出现了熟悉的情景：这具人类尸体...

say:3:1510411003:0.text: Seems like starvation, but it wasn't.
